newsitem.title: USA: U.S. safety agency sending 8-member team to Miami.
newsitem.headline: U.S. safety agency sending 8-member team to Miami.

text.p: The National Transportation Safety Board is sending an eight-member team to Miami to investigate the crash of the DC-8 cargo plane, a spokeswoman said Thursday.
An investigator from the NTSB's Miami office was already on the scene, she said, and a team led by chief investigator Robert Benzon would leave Washington for Miami later Thursday.
NTSB chairman Jim Hall would be the chief spokesman on the accident, the spokeswoman added.
Last week Benzon was sent to Newark, New Jersey, to investigate the crash of another cargo aircraft -- a Federal Express MD-11.
